Hymn 272: Oh Say, What Is Truth?
Time Signature: 6/8
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Ellen K. Jakobsen
Lyricist/Text Author: John Jaques
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 272 titled "Oh Say, What Is Truth?" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ellen K. Jakobsen and the lyrics were written by John Jaques.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
